grammar_title: 过去进行被动语态(was/were being done):动作在过去某刻正在被进行
source: 外研社新标准选择性必修二 Unit 3 Using language:过去进行被动语态 was/were being done。句子地道、围绕'时代变迁/书店/新闻业/改革/表情符号'主题、答案唯一(选项以错误语态或错误时体排除);零术语、纯应用填空。

points.point: was/were being done(过去某刻动作正在被进行)
points.overview: 过去某一时刻某动作正在进行、且主语是动作的承受者时,用 was/were being + 过去分词。常见标志:when I arrived / at that moment / right then / still / not finished yet。

points.point: 过去进行被动 vs 过去进行主动(看主语是不是施动者)
points.overview: 主语是动作承受者用被动 was/were being done;若主语自己在执行动作才用主动 was/were doing。常配 by 短语;助动词单复数须与主语一致。

points.point: 过去进行被动 vs 一般过去被动(过程未完 vs 已完成的结果)
points.overview: 强调过去某刻动作仍在进行、尚未完成,用 was/were being done;强调到某时动作已完成、只看结果(already/by then/completely),用一般过去被动 was/were done。

questions.stem: When I hurried into the shop, the books ____ into boxes right in front of me.
questions.explanation: 过去那一刻书正被装箱、书是承受者 → were being packed;'right in front of me'示进行中,排除表结果的 were packed,书不能自己装箱排除主动。

questions.stem: As I walked past the market, the old gate ____ down by the workers.
questions.explanation: 门正被工人拆、门是承受者且有 by 短语 → was being torn;主语不会自己拆排除主动,正在进行排除表结果的 was torn。

questions.stem: While all this was going on, photos ____ by a local journalist.
questions.explanation: 照片正被记者拍 → were being taken;while 引导同时进行,排除表结果的 were taken,照片是承受者排除主动。

questions.stem: When I looked up, customers' comments ____ on the big screen at that very moment.
questions.explanation: 评论那一刻正被显示 → were being displayed;'at that very moment'示进行,排除 were displayed,评论是承受者排除主动。

questions.stem: I arrived just as the wooden stands ____ from the old market.
questions.explanation: 'just as'示动作正进行、货摊被搬走 → were being removed;货摊是承受者排除主动,进行中排除表结果。

questions.stem: When the bell rang, the rubbish ____ away from the floor.
questions.explanation: 铃响那刻垃圾正被清走 → was being cleared;垃圾是承受者排除主动,正在进行排除表结果的 was cleared。

questions.stem: As we entered the store, a book reading ____ in one corner.
questions.explanation: 我们进门时朗读会正在进行 → was being delivered;活动是承受者排除主动,进行中排除表结果。

questions.stem: Right then, the tired old market ____ into a modern shopping mall.
questions.explanation: 'right then'示那刻正被改造 → was being turned;市场是承受者排除主动,进行中排除表结果的 was turned。

questions.stem: When I passed by last week, new roads ____ across the whole district.
questions.explanation: 经过时道路正被铺设 → were being paved;道路是承受者排除主动,正在进行排除表结果。

questions.stem: At that moment, the large board in the corner ____ by a big screen.
questions.explanation: 'at that moment'+ by 短语,板子正被替换 → was being replaced;板子是承受者排除主动,进行中排除表结果。

questions.stem: As I watched, the dusty shelves ____ with fresh new books.
questions.explanation: 'as I watched'示动作正进行、书架被摆满 → were being filled;书架是承受者排除主动,进行中排除表结果。

questions.stem: When the reporter called, the news story ____ for the morning paper.
questions.explanation: 记者打来时稿子正被赶写 → was being written;稿子是承受者排除主动,进行中排除表结果的 was written。

questions.stem: As the camera turned on, an interview ____ live online.
questions.explanation: 镜头开时采访正被进行 → was being done;采访是承受者排除主动,正在进行排除表结果。

questions.stem: When I stepped inside, the café tables ____ for the evening jazz concert.
questions.explanation: 进门那刻桌子正被布置 → were being set;桌子是承受者排除主动,进行中排除表结果的 were set。

questions.stem: As I came in, fresh organic food ____ in the new café.
questions.explanation: 进来时食物正被供应 → was being served;食物是承受者排除主动,进行中排除表结果。

questions.stem: When I returned, the shop's brick exterior ____ by a team of builders.
questions.explanation: 回来时外墙正被工人修缮、有 by 短语 → was being repaired;外墙是承受者排除主动,进行中排除表结果。

questions.stem: Just as I sat down, posters and gifts ____ on the front shelves.
questions.explanation: 坐下那刻海报礼品正被摆放 → were being arranged;它们是承受者排除主动,进行中排除表结果。

questions.stem: When the manager arrived, the day's best-seller ____ in the window.
questions.explanation: 经理到时畅销书正被展示 → was being shown;书是承受者排除主动,进行中排除表结果的 was shown。

questions.stem: As the crowd gathered, an old phone box ____ away from the street corner.
questions.explanation: 人群聚拢时电话亭正被搬走 → was being taken (away);电话亭是承受者排除主动,进行中排除表结果。

questions.stem: While I waited, the classic play ____ into a version full of emojis.
questions.explanation: 等候时剧本正被改编 → was being adapted;剧本是承受者排除主动,进行中排除表结果的 was adapted。

questions.stem: When the photographer arrived, the old market ____ into a shopping mall.
questions.explanation: 市场是承受者、那刻正被改造 → was being turned;主语并非施动者排除主动 was turning,单数主语排除 were。

questions.stem: All through that decade, Shenzhen ____ from a small town into a huge city.
questions.explanation: 深圳是被改变的对象 → was being transformed;城市不自行改造排除主动,单数主语排除 were。

questions.stem: While the policy was new, thousands of factories ____ across the south by investors.
questions.explanation: 工厂是承受者、有 by 短语 → were being built;工厂不会自己建排除主动,复数主语排除 was。

questions.stem: When I visited, tall skyscrapers ____ up along the river by the construction teams.
questions.explanation: 摩天楼是被建造的对象、有 by 短语 → were being put (up);它们不会自己建排除主动,复数主语排除 was。

questions.stem: As the reform went on, old wooden houses ____ down one by one by the workers.
questions.explanation: 房子是被拆的对象、有 by 短语 → were being pulled (down);房子不会自己拆排除主动,复数主语排除 was。

questions.stem: Right then, a brand-new road ____ through the busy district.
questions.explanation: 道路是被铺设的对象 → was being laid;道路不自己铺排除主动,单数主语排除 were。

questions.stem: When the journalist arrived, the news ____ straight onto the Internet.
questions.explanation: 新闻是被发布的对象 → was being released;新闻不会自己发布排除主动,单数主语排除 were。

questions.stem: In those years, more and more stories ____ on computers rather than on paper.
questions.explanation: 稿件是被编辑的对象 → were being edited;稿件不会自己编排除主动,复数主语排除 was。

questions.stem: As I watched the documentary, an old interview ____ face to face.
questions.explanation: 采访是被进行的对象 → was being done;采访不会自己进行排除主动,单数主语排除 were。

questions.stem: When the bell rang, the morning papers ____ to people's doors by the staff.
questions.explanation: 报纸是被投送的对象、有 by 短语 → were being delivered;报纸不会自己送排除主动,复数主语排除 was。

questions.stem: While the campaign went on, the bookstore ____ back to life by the whole community.
questions.explanation: 书店是被挽救的对象、有 by 短语 → was being brought (back);书店不会自己复活排除主动,单数主语排除 were。

questions.stem: When I came back, the dusty old shelves ____ with bright new books by two assistants.
questions.explanation: 书架是被摆放的对象、有 by 短语 → were being stocked;书架不会自己上货排除主动,复数主语排除 was。

questions.stem: As the café opened, organic meals ____ to literature lovers by the new staff.
questions.explanation: 餐食是被提供的对象、有 by 短语 → were being offered;餐食不会自己提供排除主动,复数主语排除 was。

questions.stem: Right at that moment, customers ____ away by online discounts and chain stores.
questions.explanation: 顾客是被吸引的对象、有 by 短语 → were being attracted;此处顾客是承受者排除主动,复数主语排除 was。

questions.stem: When the new owner took over, the corner board ____ by a digital screen.
questions.explanation: 板子是被替换的对象、有 by 短语 → was being replaced;板子不会自己替换排除主动,单数主语排除 were。

questions.stem: Throughout the spring, the town's old streets ____ by the builders.
questions.explanation: 街道是被拓宽的对象、有 by 短语 → were being widened;街道不会自己变宽排除主动,复数主语排除 was。

questions.stem: As trade grew, new markets ____ by local entrepreneurs across the region.
questions.explanation: 市场是被开办的对象、有 by 短语 → were being opened;市场不会自己开排除主动,复数主语排除 was。

questions.stem: When I arrived at the park, a welcome speech ____ to the new companies.
questions.explanation: 致辞是被发表的对象 → was being given;致辞不会自己发表排除主动,单数主语排除 were。

questions.stem: During the festival, jazz concerts ____ in the bookshop café by young musicians.
questions.explanation: 音乐会是被举办的对象、有 by 短语 → were being held;音乐会不会自己举办排除主动,复数主语排除 was。

questions.stem: While reporters watched, the old printing machines ____ out of the building by the staff.
questions.explanation: 机器是被搬走的对象、有 by 短语 → were being moved;机器不会自己搬排除主动,复数主语排除 was。

questions.stem: When I rushed in, the books ____ into boxes — the work was not finished yet.
questions.explanation: 'not finished yet'示动作仍在进行 → were being packed;若用 were packed 就成了已完成的结果,与'尚未完成'矛盾。

questions.stem: As I watched, the old gate ____ down; half of it still stood there.
questions.explanation: 'half still stood'示拆除未完 → was being pulled (down);was pulled 表已拆完的结果,与'还剩一半'矛盾。

questions.stem: Right at that moment, the news ____ onto the website, line by line.
questions.explanation: 'line by line'+ at that moment 示正在上传 → was being uploaded;was uploaded 表已传完的结果,不合。

questions.stem: While the builders worked, the brick wall ____ piece by piece.
questions.explanation: 'while…piece by piece'示修缮正进行 → was being repaired;was repaired 表已修好的结果,不合。

questions.stem: When the reporter phoned, the story ____ and was only half done.
questions.explanation: 'only half done'示写作未完 → was being written;was written 表已写完的结果,与'只写了一半'矛盾。

questions.stem: As customers looked on, fresh books ____ onto the empty shelves.
questions.explanation: 'as customers looked on'示动作正进行 → were being placed;were placed 表已摆好的结果,不合。

questions.stem: Just then, the corner board ____ with a new screen, and wires still hung loose.
questions.explanation: 'wires still hung loose'示更换未完 → was being replaced;was replaced 表已换好的结果,与'电线还松垂'矛盾。

questions.stem: While I waited, my friend's message ____ in emojis, one symbol at a time.
questions.explanation: 'one symbol at a time'示正在输入 → was being typed;was typed 表已打完的结果,不合。

questions.stem: As the festival opened, a jazz concert ____ on the little stage right then.
questions.explanation: 'right then'示那刻正在举办 → was being held;was held 表已结束的一次活动,与'正进行'不合。

questions.stem: When I returned at noon, the market ____ into a mall, with cranes still working.
questions.explanation: 'cranes still working'示改造未完 → was being turned;was turned 表已改造完的结果,与'吊车还在作业'矛盾。

questions.stem: By the time I got there, the books ____ into boxes, and the shelves were already empty.
questions.explanation: 'by the time…already empty'示动作已完成、只看结果 → were packed;were being packed 表过程进行,与'已装完、架空了'矛盾。

questions.stem: When I arrived, the old gate ____ down completely; only a pile of bricks remained.
questions.explanation: 'completely…only bricks remained'示已拆完 → was pulled (down);was being pulled 表正在拆,与'已全拆完'矛盾。

questions.stem: By last night, the news ____ on every website, and everyone had already read it.
questions.explanation: 'by last night…already read'示已发布完 → was released;was being released 表正在发布,与'大家都读过了'矛盾。

questions.stem: When the editor checked it, the story ____ and ready to print.
questions.explanation: 'ready to print'示已完成 → was finished;was being finished 表正在收尾,与'已可付印'不合。

questions.stem: By the time the café opened, the new shelves ____ with hundreds of books.
questions.explanation: 'by the time…opened'示开门前已摆满 → were filled;were being filled 表正在摆放,与'已摆满'不合。

questions.stem: When I looked again, the corner board ____ by a screen, and the change was complete.
questions.explanation: 'the change was complete'示已换好 → was replaced;was being replaced 表正在更换,与'更换已完成'矛盾。

questions.stem: By spring, the whole market ____ into a modern mall, and shoppers were already inside.
questions.explanation: 'by spring…already inside'示已改造完 → was turned;was being turned 表正在改造,与'顾客已在里面'矛盾。

questions.stem: When the staff arrived, the morning papers ____ and stacked neatly by the door.
questions.explanation: 'stacked neatly'示已送达并码好 → were delivered;were being delivered 表正在投送,与'已码好'不合。

questions.stem: By the end of the week, the old phone box ____ from the corner, and the street looked bare.
questions.explanation: 'by the end…looked bare'示已搬走 → was removed;was being removed 表正在搬,与'已不见、街角空了'矛盾。

questions.stem: When I opened the book, I saw that some scenes ____ into emojis already.
questions.explanation: 'already'示已改编完 → were adapted;were being adapted 表正在改编,与'已经改完'矛盾。
